senses.gloss:
निभ नि-भ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. भा with
नि), like, resembling, similar, (only at the end of a
comp.; sometimes pleonastically after adjectives, e. g.
चारु-निभानन, handsome-faced; and occasionally
with another word meaning ‘like,’ e. g. नग-निभो-
पम, like a mountain); (अस्, अम्), m. n. appear-
ance, light, manifestation; pretence, pretext, fraud,
sham, trick, disguise.
—निभ-ता, f. similarity, likeness.

निभञ्ज् नि-भञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. -भनक्ति, -भङ्क्-
तुम्, to break or dash to pieces, break asunder.

निभर्त्सन नि-भर्त्सन, wrong reading for
निर्-भर्त्सन.

निभल् नि-भल्, cl. 10. P. A. -भालयति,
-ते, -यितुम्, to perceive, see.

नि-भालन, अम्, n. seeing, sight, perception;
[cf. नि-फालन.]

निभसद् नि-भसद् (?), having the hinder
parts directed downwards (?). See भसद्.

निभिद् नि-भिद्, cl. 7. P. A. -भिनत्ति,
-भिन्त्ते, -भेत्तुम्, to break or divide asunder: Pass.
-भिद्यते, to be opened, to open.

निभीम नि-भीम, अस्, आ, अम्, terrible, fright-
ful.
—निभीम-विक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, of terrible
valour, of formidable prowess.
निभूत नि-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, past, gone.

निभूयप निभूयप, अस्, m., Ved. epithet
of Viṣṇu, (meaning unknown.)

निभृ नि-भृ, cl. 1. P. -भरति, -भर्तुम्,
&c., to bear or put down, (apparently only used in
the part. नि-भृत below.)

नि-भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, borne or placed down, deposited
in a low place, lowered; concealed, hidden, secret,
occult, unperceived, imperceptible; modest, humble,
unassuming; mild, gentle; lonely, solitary; still, silent;
firm, unmoved, immovable; resolute, decided, firmly
attached, faithful; filled with, full of, (Bhāgavata-Purāṇa
X. 32, 20, = पूर्ण, व्याप्त); (अम्), n. humility,
modesty, meekness [cf. नैभृत्य]; (अम्), ind.
covertly, secretly, privately, apart, unobservedly, im-
perceptibly, in a corner, out of sight.
—निभृतागत
(˚त-आग्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, secretly arrived.
—निभृतात्-
मन् (˚त-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, resolute-minded, resolute.
—निभृतार्थ (˚त-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having a
secret meaning, occult.

निभ्रंश् नि-भ्रंश्, Caus. -भ्राशयति, -यितुम्,
Ved. to cause to fall off, to strike or break off.
